title: question body (sealed)
description: Ask another Obi something its owner knows, has decided, or has let it tell. One question goes to one Obi: to ask several, send one to each (spec/protocol.md, 'question'). Sealed: derived from actions/question.schema.json by spec/conformance/generate.mjs, every x-obi-text field a sealed_text (spec/protocol.md section 9.1). Don't edit it by hand.

text.description: The question, in the asker's words.

about.description: What it is about: repositories, pull requests, issues, or the receiving Obi's jobs.

choices.description: Allowed answers, when it is multiple choice.
